u0: The agent has not yet located the matching key, or has located it without breaking any tracked condition; the ball has not been picked up, so the task is still in progress. The objectives are to find the matching key, to have the locked door open by the end, and finally to pick up the ball. If the ball is picked up before the key is found, the episode still counts as successful once the pickup occurs.
u1: The task is complete: the ball has been picked up while the locked door was open (or before any obligation to open it arose), so all mandatory requirements are satisfied. No further objectives remain, as the episode ends on picking up the ball.
u2: The matching key has been located but the locked door is still closed and the ball has not been picked up. The pending requirement is to open the locked door with the matching key and then pick up the ball. Until the door is opened, picking up the ball would end the episode without the door ever being opened, which fails the task; if the door is opened, progress returns to the ordinary waiting state.
u3: The ball has been picked up, but the locked door is still closed even though the matching key was found. The episode can still succeed only by opening the locked door; otherwise the pending requirement is violated at the end. No other objective remains once the door is opened.
